cases.name: cache_serve_flush
cases.eval: $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']='GET'; $_POST=array(); $_COOKIE=array(); $_GET=array(); $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']='/en/ok'; $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']='t.ecomae.com'; $dir=epc_page_cache_dir(); $key=epc_page_cache_key(); $file=$dir.'/'.$key.'.html'; @unlink($file); @unlink($file.'.meta'); $miss=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); file_put_contents($file, 'short'); $short=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); file_put_contents($file, str_repeat('x',120)); $nodoctype=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); $splash='<!doctype html><html><body class="epc-platform-status">Service update</body></html>'; file_put_contents($file, $splash); $spl=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); $ok='<!doctype html><html><body>Hello cache page content here</body></html>'; file_put_contents($file, $ok); file_put_contents($file.'.meta', json_encode(array('exp'=>time()+60))); ob_start(); $hit=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); $hitHtml=ob_get_clean(); file_put_contents($file.'.meta', json_encode(array('exp'=>time()-10))); $exp=epc_page_cache_try_serve(); $GLOBALS['__epc_page_cache_active']=true; $GLOBALS['__epc_page_cache_ttl']=90; ob_start(); echo '<!doctype html><html><body>'.str_repeat('Z',200).'</html>'; epc_page_cache_flush(); $flushed=is_file($file) && strlen((string)file_get_contents($file))>200; $purged=epc_page_cache_purge_all(); return array($miss,$short,$nodoctype,$spl,$hit,substr($hitHtml,0,15),$exp,$flushed,$purged>0);

cases.name: anom_seed
cases.eval: $pdo=$GLOBALS['db_link']; $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE epc_ci_violations (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, site_key VARCHAR(64), ip VARCHAR(64), created_at DATETIME)'); $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE epc_mfa_audit_log (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, action VARCHAR(32), success TINYINT, created_at DATETIME)'); for($i=0;$i<12;$i++){ $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO epc_ci_violations (site_key,ip,created_at) VALUES (?,?,NOW())')->execute(array('siteA','1.1.1.1')); } for($i=0;$i<3;$i++){ $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO epc_ci_violations (site_key,ip,created_at) VALUES (?,?,NOW())')->execute(array('siteB','1.1.1.1')); } for($i=0;$i<6;$i++){ $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO epc_ci_violations (site_key,ip,created_at) VALUES (?,?,DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR))')->execute(array('siteC','2.2.2.2')); $pdo->exec('UPDATE epc_ci_violations SET created_at = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR), "%Y-%m-%d 03:00:00") WHERE site_key="siteC"'); } for($i=0;$i<7;$i++){ $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO epc_mfa_audit_log (user_id,action,success,created_at) VALUES (9,"verify_failed",0,NOW())')->execute(); } $r=epc_anomaly_scan($pdo); unset($r['scan_time']); $fleet=epc_anomaly_fleet_stats($pdo); $id=epc_anomaly_record($pdo,'siteZ','manual',array('severity'=>'low','description'=>'note','risk_score'=>3)); $res=epc_anomaly_resolve($pdo,$id,7,'ok'); $fleet2=epc_anomaly_fleet_stats($pdo); return array($r['scanned'],$r['anomalies_found'],$r['details']['violation_spikes']['check'], count($r['details']['violation_spikes']['anomalies']), $r['details']['violation_spikes']['anomalies'][0]['type'] ?? null, $r['details']['multi_tenant_ip']['anomalies'][0]['type'] ?? null, $r['details']['after_hours']['anomalies'][0]['severity'] ?? null, $r['details']['mfa_bypass']['anomalies'][0]['type'] ?? null, $fleet['unresolved_total'], $id>0, $res, $fleet2['unresolved_total']);
